picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's selection under DOE's new Genesis Mission puts a national lab-led team in charge of using AI to solve long-standing particle accelerator timing and frequency instabilities — a concrete step toward AI-accelerated scientific infrastructure with national strategic backing.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: Penn's implantable Smart Neurostimulation System, built on decades of computational memory modeling, moves AI-driven neurotechnology from theory to a real device that predicts and treats memory loss.
picks.title: A ‘breakthrough’ to restore memory | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's new AI compression method addresses a looming bottleneck for every data-intensive scientific facility, offering a way to preserve subtle experimental detail while shrinking storage demands at scale.
picks.title: SLAC researchers develop AI-based tool to compress data without losing detail

picks.editorial_note: A second Genesis Mission award, this one Alabama-led, extends the DOE's national push to apply AI to physics data analysis — signaling the initiative's breadth across institutions.
picks.title: UA Preview — Aug. 24-30, 2026

picks.editorial_note: The $9M NSF-funded iDLab unifies browser-based access to national HPC centers across NCSA, UCLA and partners, directly advancing the NAIRR vision of democratized AI compute access.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell's creation of an entire new department around Dan Landau, pioneer of AI-powered liquid biopsy for cancer detection, signals institutional commitment to computational biomedicine as a durable research pillar.
picks.title: Dr. Dan Landau Named Inaugural Chair of the Department of Systems and Computational Biomedicine at Weill Cornell Medicine
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo's new industry-academia cluster pairs a commercial AI drug-discovery platform with academic biomedical research, a model for accelerating pharmaceutical R&D through formal cross-sector collaboration.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: A $1.5M NSF grant backs a multi-institution effort (KU, Stony Brook University, and the Stowers Institute) to model macromolecular systems over extra-long timescales, pushing AI-driven molecular simulation capabilities forward.
picks.title: $1.5 million NSF grant will support KU research modeling molecular systems using AI

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's decision to give every team in the world's toughest solar car race access to Claude marks a notable real-world deployment of frontier AI in engineering competition, expanding CSIRO's technology partnership.
picks.title: World's toughest solar race unlocks AI access for all teams

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston's projection of a 32% electricity demand rise by 2030, driven substantially by AI data centers, is a policy-relevant warning that could shape energy infrastructure planning nationwide.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston
